title: 5/05 unposted pick stayed committed to a postponed game (abstract-status lock); follow-on void grading, polling-gate and detailed-status fixes through 5/26
tier_reason: delivery impact: on 5/05 an unposted stale pick committed to a postponed game was treated as locked instead of regenerated (a 'production failure'); the deferred cached-fallback residual can still deliver a postponed-game pick

contract.text: An unposted pick whose committed game is postponed, cancelled or missing from the schedule is regenerated from live games; a locked slot whose game is postponed/cancelled is void (neither hit nor miss) and does not block result polling.
contract.source: commit 7b701c9 (classify_pick_lock_state docstring); commit a142c14 body; docs/superpowers/runbooks/2026-05-09-live-forward-daily-ops.md 'Postponement handling'; BTS rules section 6 Pass (design §10.1)

mechanism.text: run_single_check short-circuited as 'Pick already locked' whenever the existing pick's primary game had abstract status other than 'P'; a postponed game is not 'P', so the stale unposted pick was kept and the cascade never ran to replace it
grading had no void result: a locked slot whose game was postponed/cancelled could not be scored as a Pass, so a double-down day could not be scored from the played slot

run_result_polling's all-final gate waited on every locked game's live feed; a postponed game's feed still reported Preview, so polling could not complete (and could overwrite resolved results at the cap)
candidate filtering and lock-gap decisions used abstract statuses only, so candidates from games that were abstract-Preview but detailed-Postponed stayed eligible
when the detailed status lookup failed, live pick generation silently fell back to abstract statuses, degrading the postponed/cancelled protection

residual.text: Deferred: the cached-fallback safety net can deliver a pick whose game went postponed when the refresh finds no eligible replacement, and postponed_pick health ignores delivered picks (L03).
residual.source: docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md 'F1 DEFERRED (pre-existing)'; design §10.3 postponed cached fallback

residual.text: check-pick-entered has no postponed-game awareness: a pre-pitch postponement keeps nagging for a selection that will Pass (product call pending).

watchdog.trigger: before the earliest pick game's cutoff, the day's committed or candidate pick names a game whose detailed status is Postponed/Cancelled or which is missing from the schedule, and no regenerated pick exists
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the day ends with a pick on a played game or a recorded deliberate skip; any locked postponed slot is graded void and polling completes
